title: Chapter 1879: Manifest Shore Immortal Plant (I)

Chapter 1879: Manifest Shore Immortal Plant (I)

Descending from Lesser Broadsky Mountain, they entered the Western Sea. The earth veins were abundant, but spiritual energy was sparse. The seabed rose and fell, and few demonic creatures were to be seen. The scenery was very different from that of the Eastern Sea.

The three divine ability cultivators followed the earth veins, venturing deeper against the flow of baleful qi. The terrain became increasingly deep and perilous. Though Li Ximing had the Immortal Artifact, with Yinxin leading the way, there was no need to invite suspicion.

He remarked casually, "It is hidden quite deep... You are capable indeed, fellow Daoist, to have found it."

Rogue Cultivator Yinxin smiled. "Though I cultivate in the Western Sea, I spend much of my time traveling through the Abyss of Inferior Water, and my divine ability has certain useful properties. I first noticed that Fellow Daoist Zang Tiaozi of Shiqi came and went every few years. After happening upon him twice, I began paying closer attention. Later, through inquiries, I learned that Fellow Daoist Zang Tiaozi possessed [Manifest Shore White Blossoms], which he supplied to several Daoists for cultivation."

His gaze was rather cold and sinister as he continued evenly, "There should not have been so many of those blossoms, nor any reason for him to come here year after year. I suspected then that Zang Tiaozi had a spirit root... But movement is difficult in the Abyss of Inferior Water, and no matter how I searched, I could not find an opening.

"Still, my search was not fruitless. I saw Shehu sneaking back from the Abyss of Inferior Water. After some thought, I turned my attention to him, only to discover that they had merely chosen a place to conduct their transactions..."

Li Ximing raised his brows. "An impressive divine ability, fellow Daoist, to uncover so much detail."

Rogue Cultivator Yinxin smiled. Though his expression was courteous, his sinister bearing still made him somewhat chilling. "I cultivate [Stable Earth], the orthodox path of banishing, halting, and profound shifting. My divine ability is called [Orthodox Source Valley]. I saw him descend into a particular part of the sea and remembered the spot. By connecting to the earth veins and calculating from there, I could determine the location."

He smiled and said, "Spirit roots must always connect to the earth veins. That demonic creature was stingy and timid, and never found an opportunity to build a Purple Mansion Realm formation to protect his spirit root. That made it even easier to calculate its location.

"It is most likely a [Solitary White Brahma Thicket], which regularly produces [Manifest Shore White Blossoms]... Since it is a living spirit root, it will surely fare better in our hands, where we can tend it with care, than it did with that demonic creature!"

There were many Stable Earth cultivators, but very few possessed an established Dao lineage. Li Ximing could not help taking another look at him. "There is a cultivator in Jiangnan who also cultivates [Stable Earth]. However, his divine ability is [Fool's Mountain Chase]..."

Rogue Cultivator Yinxin scoffed. "[Fool's Mountain Chase]... That divine ability was used in Tongxuan Immortal Palace to supplement She Earth[1]. Did he inherit some unorthodox lineage passed down from who knows where? If one insists, it can barely be considered [Stable Earth]... But its mystics..."

He left the 'brought shame to Stable Earth' unspoken. Having said so much, he likely came from a Dao lineage of considerable standing and meant to intimidate the two, discouraging them from entertaining any other ideas.

Li Ximing took note of his words. Sensing that the man was likely proud at heart, he deliberately provoked him. "

Oh?

But that senior's lineage has been recognized by the Pavilion of Profound Order. Though the Five Earths all belong to the Five Elements, there are differences in standing among them. The one that becomes a heavenly glow in the sky is probably the most influential."

Rogue Cultivator Yinxin did indeed fall silent for a moment. "That concerns the immortals of the Tongxuan Dao lineage. Lesser cultivators like us are in no position to speculate."

He keeps his mouth shut...

Though Yinxin said little, Li Ximing had learned a fair amount. He chuckled inwardly,

So he isn't a Tongxuan cultivator either! I wonder where his Earth Virtue inheritance came from...

As they spoke, they reached the depths of the sea trench, where the waters were dark and heavy. Li Zhouwei swept his golden gaze over the area and immediately saw through an illusion. The formation, thin as a cicada's wing, broke at a flick of his finger, revealing a grotto heaven beyond!

Dim light filled the cavern. Amid its vast halls and underground rivers stood countless ruined palaces, surrounding a purple lake at the center. An ancient tree rose from the lake.

The tree stood over one hundred and thirty meters tall, its canopy spreading like a cloud and bearing scattered patches of ice and snow. Its branches and leaves were entirely white. Several white blossoms adorned its branches, each as large as a human face, with gold and silver stamens and a rich fragrance.

The lake lay still as a mirror, reflecting the branches and leaves. Faint yet profoundly moving mournful music floated through the air.

Li Zhouwei glanced around and smiled. "What a wicked creature."

As Li Ximing studied the scene, he gathered the [Light of the Six Directions] in his hand. Holding it like a wisp of flame, he raised it to his lips and blew gently.

Everything before them shattered like a reflection in a lake. The ruined palaces and layered scenery vanished. The cavern was only the size of a small hall, with faint silver-white formation patterns flickering across its floor and dim white light filling the space. At its center stood a small, graceful spirit shrub resembling a tea tree, its branches and leaves spreading freely.

Rogue Cultivator Yinxin stood rooted to the spot as he thought,

It isn't a [Solitary White Brahma Thicket]?

The tea-like spirit root before him had golden branches and snow-white leaves, with white blossoms dotting its boughs. The sight made Yinxin retreat a step in disbelief, immediately putting distance between himself and the other two!

Li Ximing felt a wave of Lesser Yang light wash over his face, bright as moonlight falling on snow but without any chill. Realizing something had changed, he immediately gripped the spirit treasure in his hand and watched warily.

The atmosphere throughout the cave dwelling grew strange at once. Li Zhouwei, however, showed little reaction. His golden eyes surveyed the place from top to bottom before he said calmly, "The spiritual energy here is unusual. Neither sun nor moon shines upon it, and the various energies are in harmony. The nourishing influence of Lesser Yang is perfectly suited to preserving this spirit item.

“It isn't that the demon chose not to set up a formation. He simply lacked the ability to establish a Purple Mansion Realm formation without disrupting the spiritual energy."

His words ruled out any possibility of them fighting here. Rogue Cultivator Yinxin showed no sign of anything amiss. Counting on his fingers, he said quietly, with some uncertainty, "This is a [Small-Leaf Manifest Shore Immortal Plant], a Purple Mansion Realm spirit root of [Lesser Yang]. So the [Manifest Shore White Blossoms] actually came from here... Shehu certainly knew how to hide it!

"Ever since Lesser Yang split into three, this spirit root was severed from its source. Its leaves turned from white to pale yellow, its twelve branches became four, and it became the [Solitary White Brahma Thicket]... This particular plant must be extraordinarily ancient!"

Li Ximing glanced at it and thought to himself,

In that case, it cannot be moved. Once exposed to the spiritual aura of the outside world, it would deteriorate day by day and gradually become a lesser spirit root...

Meanwhile, the golden-eyed young man had been examining the place closely. Finding it almost frighteningly perfect, he began to pace, his gaze sweeping over the light on the ground. He remained silent for a long while as suspicion gnawed at his thoughts.

Was a place so exquisitely suited to the plant... truly formed by nature?

After pondering for some time, Li Zhouwei used the Immortal Mirror to examine the surroundings carefully once more. He still found nothing unusual.

There is only this one site... no trace of anything elsewhere. But if a cultivator created it... how many people in the world possess such profound Dao conduct? How could someone like Shehu possibly have done it? Was it truly formed by nature?

His gaze grew colder. Closing his eyes slightly, he recalled the demon's earlier plea.

Since you have come from Jiangnan, you must know of my past. I am willing to offer the spirit root to you both, my lords...

He linked the spirit root to his past... Perhaps he found a clue to it through that earlier connection. That would explain things... I should look further.

He turned and glanced at the [Small-Leaf Manifest Shore Immortal Plant]. "Since we agreed to divide the spoils, let us first take the four mature [Manifest Shore White Blossoms] on this spirit root."

Rogue Cultivator Yinxin immediately spoke up, seemingly afraid the two would damage the spirit root. "This is among the most delicate Lesser Yang spirit materials. It fears both fire and baleful qi, so it is best collected in a wooden box."

Li Zhouwei watched him covertly and continued, "As for the spirit root..."

Yinxin's heart rose into his throat, and hesitation crossed his face. The young man before him, however, said casually, "Let us cut it down here and divide it between us!"

Even Li Ximing's eyes betrayed a pang of distress at those words, to say nothing of Rogue Cultivator Yinxin. His expression changed drastically, and he cried, "Absolutely not! How could we turn such a fine spirit root into firewood?"

1. Referring to Manifest Earth. ☜
